title: Hidden Tears
meta: Output: Diasec Print (Plexiglas + Alucobond), Fine Art Print (Hahnemühle Photo Rag / German Etching), Custom Archival on request
Framing: Diasec ready-to-hang with aluminum backing; fine art prints shipped rolled
statement:
Her eyes are closed, but the feeling is loud. In this fractured stillness, tears fall inward. In places where freedom is uneven, emotions become secrets – held behind the skin, pressed down into silence.

This piece is not just about women. It's about all of us – the quiet wars we fight inside.
